Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFExternalSignatureSigner

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFExternalSignatureSigner
public final class CPDFExternalSignatureSigner extends Object
Creates PDF signatures using complete containers returned by an external service.

Initialize the SDK first and run signing on a worker thread. This API is independent of AWS KMS and does not configure service credentials or transport. The provider supplies the complete CMS container; the SDK prepares and fills the PDF using PDF Core.

  • Method Details

    • signWithContainer

      public static CPDFSignatureCreateResult signWithContainer(String input, String output, CPDFSignatureOptions options, CPDFSignatureContainerProvider provider)
      Signs a saved PDF in a new field using a synchronous container callback.

      The input must remain unchanged during signing. The output must differ from the input, must not exist, and must have an existing writable parent directory. This entry point has no PDF-open-password parameter. Temporary files are isolated per call and removed on completion, including callback failures.

      The callback receives a SHA-256 digest. Its result must contain one complete detached CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData value with signer information. Malformed, attached, empty or oversized containers are rejected before publication. Reserve sufficient space with CPDFSignatureOptions.setEstimatedContentsSize(int); the callback is not retried automatically when the container is too large.

      The PDF uses adbe.pkcs7.detached. This entry point does not select a PAdES profile, add a timestamp or collect LTV evidence. It does not guarantee LT/LTA, even if the provider includes PAdES attributes. Inspect the profile reports before using CPDFPadesSigner.prolongLtv(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions) on the output.

      Creation and validation are separate. A structurally valid container for the wrong digest can still be published; inspect CPDFSignatureCreateResult.getValidationResult() even when creation succeeds. Verification is enabled by default. If disabled, no cryptographic validity or trust conclusion is provided.

      Parameters:
      input - the readable source PDF path
      output - the new signed PDF path
      options - field, container-size and verification settings; null uses defaults
      provider - the synchronous container provider; null produces sdk.container.provider_missing
      Returns:
      the creation result, published path and diagnostics, plus validation when enabled; provider exceptions become sdk.container.provider_exception
